title: An end-to-end recurrent compressed sensing method to denoise, detect and demix calcium imaging data
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Denoise, detect and demix neurons in the original ten experimental Allen two-photon videos. Primary ordered comparison is original manual-ROI segmentation F1; extracted trace accuracy and runtime remain separately reported source endpoints, not substituted for segmentation.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Denoise, detect and demix neurons in the original ten experimental Allen two-photon videos. Primary ordered comparison is original manual-ROI segmentation F1; extracted trace accuracy and runtime remain separately reported source endpoints, not substituted for segmentation.

Source-paper comparison for Arithmetic mean segmentation F1 across the ten original Allen experimental videos, using strict IoU>0.5: Match each manual reference ROI to the highest-overlap predicted ROI with strict IoU>0.5. F1=2TP/(Npred+Nref). For trace correlation use the reference ROIs detected by every compared method; those imaging-derived traces do not measure electrical ground truth. Ambiguous many-reference matching requires source resolution.
success_criteria: Authenticate all ten original recording/frame/manual-reference mappings and the exact full-model checkpoint and native preprocessing/assembly.
Reproduce source-author per-video F1 and its ten-video mean, keeping the published 0.847 and rerun result distinct.
Evaluate candidate on all ten original videos under identical source labels, IoU matching and macro-video aggregation; no reduced recordings, new depths, external donors or mini-demo substitutes.

Keep trace comparison on common detected ROIs and disclose its imaging-derived reference; separately retain original trace/runtime endpoints when claiming improvement of the complete denoise/detect/demix task.
Freeze method, permitted training/access, reference exposure, meaningful effect, uncertainty rule and concrete resource budget before the final comparison.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
